labels: Every row is a BTC15m market this account SETTLED at the venue. Nothing here is shadow, replay, simulated or proposed. The TOTAL is the authoritative cashflow; the matched/residual split is AVERAGE-COST attribution and is method dependent. Rows with cost_basis_placeholder carry the $1/share unknown-basis UPPER BOUND, so their loss is OVERSTATED and they are excluded from every per-unit rate.
source: our own PMUS ledger, L5_LIVE_SETTLED rows, service l5-pmus-live

by_basis_quality.note: the placeholder loss is an upper bound, not a measured loss

breakeven.note: computed from VENUE-CONFIRMED per-unit figures only

placeholder_basis_reconstruction.labels: THESE ARE NOT MEASURED LOSSES. Each of the 17 rows is a single-sided leg whose cost_total equals its quantity exactly, i.e. the $1/share placeholder. Settlement is venue-confirmed; only the PRICE is unknown. A winning leg is therefore reported as $0.00 when it actually GAINED, and a losing leg as -qty when it actually lost only -qty*price.
placeholder_basis_reconstruction.bound_method: the engine refuses a first leg outside [0.20,0.60], so for engine-placed legs the fill price is bounded by that band. These legs appear in reconcile as leg_cost_basis_unknown (adopted from the venue), so if any was not engine-placed only the unconstrained (0,1) bound binds.
placeholder_basis_reconstruction.recovery_requires: a venue query of /v1/portfolio/activities for these markets. These dates are outside Railway log retention and the fill prices are not in this repository; this container holds no PMUS credentials.

account_total_corrected.labels: the single -53.2674 figure summed a MEASURED -1.6874 with a $1/share UPPER BOUND of -51.5800 and reported the sum as realized. It must not be quoted as a measured loss.
